eligibility.evidence: Sec. 1 and 3.1 follow the graph recall protocol of Brashears and Quintane (2015) with a word span memory-clearance step; Sec. 3.3 compares GPT-3.5, GPT-4 and Gemini-Pro with that human study; App. D replicates a sex-prime manipulation. Borderline because four of five datasets are graph benchmarks without a human counterpart.

E.headline: LLMs recall graphs imperfectly, show human-like triangle bias stronger than humans, recall best with domain-matched narratives, and show no sex-prime effect.

G.notes: Table 2 (human comparison) is garbled in the converted text, so no effect sizes were taken. Sex-prime result is 'insignificant in most cases' with no per-model values. Temperature not stated. Llama-2 results not reported. The word span test is a filler, not coded as a paradigm. Main-text accuracy rows could equally be coded accuracy.
